newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sells 22.67 bln levs one and 4-wk T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sells 22.67 bln levs one and 4-wk T-bills.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry on Monday sold two discount T-bill issues with maturities of one week and four weeks, yielding 3.84 percent and 17.70 percent to maturity, respectively, the central bank said.
Bids were received for a total of 24.981 billion levs of T-bills but the ministry approved bids for 22.666 billion levs worth of paper.
The issues were offered with no par value or minimum acceptable price set in advance by the ministry. Auction date and maturity date for each issue overlap.
Details of the issues follow. Prices are in percent of par:
Bids received 13,419.6 mln levs 11,561.5 mln levs
Bids approved 11,604.6 mln levs 11,061.5 mln levs
Avg yield to maturity 3.84 pct 17.70 pct
